items.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
items.summary: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.

items.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
items.summary: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs see largest daily outflows in four months following record Binance hack
items.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs shed $643 million on Friday, marking their largest single-day outflow since June 25, following Thursday's Binance's hack.

items.title: Ethena Explained: USDe, sUSDe, Rewards and Exit Routes
items.summary: Direct issuer redemption is restricted, while sUSDe unstaking returns USDe—not dollars in a bank account.
